name: wandering stones on a seven by four
description: A seven by four board whose middle file (d) is a wall, so the play is on two three by four fields. Every other square starts with a stone, the two players' alternating like the colours of a checkerboard. A move takes an enemy stone on an orthogonally adjacent square, moving onto it, or steps a stone into an empty orthogonally adjacent square. The player who cannot move loses; a game still going at sixty plies is drawn.
summary: Two three by four fields of stones.
A stone takes or steps orthogonally.
The player who cannot move loses.
